data.name: City Build Island
data.detailed_description:
About the Game

This title is a unique simulation game that combines island-building with tower defense.
As the administrator of a small island, players gather resources, construct facilities, and enrich the lives of their villagers.
At the same time, they must strategically place defensive structures to protect the settlement from invading enemies.
How you balance development and defense will greatly influence the progress of your game.

Story & Objective

The island was once an uninhabited land, but under the player’s guidance it gradually transforms into a place where people can live and thrive.
While increasing the population and developing the village, players must also face constant threats from nature and external enemies.
Your objective is to build a prosperous settlement while defending your people from invasion.
Will you create a peaceful paradise, or forge a stronghold through battle and survival? The choice is yours.

Tower Defense Elements

Enemy forces attack in waves, pressing forward to invade your island.
Players must use their resources to build defensive structures, control enemy routes, and repel the assaults.
The outcome of each battle changes greatly depending on the type and placement of towers, requiring strategies tailored to different enemy characteristics.

  • Variety of Defenses: Arrow towers, walls, defensive units, and more

  • Enemy Variations: Fast-moving scouts, heavily armored foes, and other unique threats

  • Strategic Depth: Limited resources mean that construction order and placement are key to victory

The joy of expanding your settlement is fused with the tension of surviving relentless enemy waves, creating a one-of-a-kind gameplay experience.

Easy-to-Play Controls

This game is designed for accessibility, with most actions playable using only the mouse.
Gathering resources, placing buildings, and setting up defenses are all simple and intuitive, allowing smooth and fast-paced progression.
There is no need to memorize complex key combinations—anyone can easily enjoy both the creativity of island-building and the strategy of defense.
Players can bring their vision of an ideal island to life without stress.

Planned Updates After Release

To expand gameplay possibilities, we plan to introduce:

  • Enhanced tower defense features

  • Additional NPCs and resources

  • New placeable items

  • Other new content and features

We will continue development to deliver an even better experience, so please look forward to what’s to come!

data.short_description: Collect resources, build structures, and develop a small island in this island-building simulation. As the overseer, you’ll grow your village while defending against invading enemies. Enjoy a unique experience that blends city-building and tower defense gameplay.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.0GHz
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
